claude.sample_unit: webpages of burns first aid patient education materials

links.outcome: Readability of burns first aid materials before and after AI rewriting to an 11-year-old literacy level
links.effect: Original: 4% met target on all tools, median grade 6.9. After AI: 18% met target, median grade 6 (p<.001); all readability scores improved significantly (p<.001).
links.quote: Once rewritten using AI, paired t-test demonstrated that all readability scores improved significantly (p < .001).

links.outcome: Proportion of patient education materials meeting target reading level
links.effect: In original form, only 4% of PEMs met the target readability level across all tools; median grade 6.9 (SD=1.1), not significantly below target (p = .31).
links.quote: In their original form, only 4% of the patient education materials (PEMs) met the target readability level across all tools.

links.outcome: Readability of burns first aid materials
links.effect: Original: 4% met target; AI-modified: 18% met target, median grade 6 (SD=0.9), all scores improved p < .001.
links.quote: Once rewritten using AI, paired t-test demonstrated that all readability scores improved significantly (p < .001).

links.outcome: Readability of AI-modified patient education materials
links.effect: Only 18% of AI-modified PEMs reached target readability level across all tools, though median grade was 6 (SD=0.9, p < .001)
links.quote: After AI-modification, 18% of PEMs reached the target level using all tools, with a median grade of 6 (SD=0.9), which was significantly below the target level (p < .001).

links.outcome: Reading level of AI-modified patient education materials
links.effect: Only 18% of AI-modified PEMs reached target readability level across all tools, though median grade was 6 (SD=0.9, p < .001)
links.quote: After AI-modification, 18% of PEMs reached the target level using all tools, with a median grade of 6 (SD=0.9), which was significantly below the target level (p < .001).
